neighbours.label: an imperative verb addressing the reader in instructions (use, provide, be sure, check), as opposed to the same verbs describing what someone did
fire: Before submitting the form, check that every field is complete.
To install the package, run the setup script from the main folder.
In your answer, describe two causes of the French Revolution.
For best results, use fresh herbs rather than dried ones.
When you are done, return the keys to the front desk.
After reading the passage, summarize its main argument in one paragraph.
If the light flashes red, unplug the device and wait ten seconds.
Using the data in Table 2, calculate the average monthly rainfall.
quiet: Before submitting the form, the clerk checks that every field is complete.
To install the package, the team ran the setup script from the main folder.
In her answer, the student described two causes of the French Revolution.
For best results, the chef uses fresh herbs rather than dried ones.
When they were done, the guests returned the keys to the front desk.
After reading the passage, the class summarized its main argument in one paragraph.
If the light flashes red, the device unplugs itself and waits ten seconds.
Using the data in Table 2, the authors calculated the average monthly rainfall.
